description: Sample reinforcement responses. Quantities that can be recorded include displacement-axial, displacement-shear, force-axial, force-shear, strain-axial, strain-shear, element-id. The nodes of an element will be ordered counterclockwise with respect to the outside of the zone faces upon which the reinforcement was created.

keywords.name: displacement-axial
keywords.description: Get axial displacement in the element.

keywords.name: displacement-shear
keywords.description: Get shear displacement in the element.

keywords.name: strain-axial
keywords.description: Get axial strain in the element.

keywords.name: strain-shear
keywords.description: Get shear strain in the element.

keywords.name: position
keywords.description: The particular element is identified by ( v ) coordinates (the nearest element is taken). If this keyword is used, element-id and node-id should not be used.

keywords.name: element-id
keywords.description: The particular element is identified by the element ID number. If this keyword is used, position and node-id should not be used.

keywords.name: name
keywords.description: Live-enumerated at this slot on 3DEC 7.00 (Release 161); absent from the 7.0 HTML page. Semantics uncurated.
